dct_description_sm: Abstract: This layer shows paved surfaces, including roadways, edges of pavement, sidewalks, parking areas, driveways, bridges, alleys, and footpaths. There are some unpaved items in this layer.

Purpose: This polygon data layer is used for the city base map as well as for detailed mapping. The layer can be broken down by feature code, or f-codes, which are listed below. An effort to get the maximum number of pavement breaks was incorporated into this layer to support needs from the DPW, Traffic & Parking, Community Development Department, and Inspectional Services Department.
